description: The reading status of one edition for one reader: an edition, the (optional) shelf it was filed under, and its progress metadata. One record per edition, so a status change replaces the previous one rather than adding a shelf membership. The rkey is the edition record's rkey (the last segment of the catalog edition URI).

shelf.description: AT-URI of the parent shelf record (e.g. at://did/biblio.shelf/reading).

book.description: The book on the shelf (catalog record URI).

metadata.description: Status and optional position/notes/emoji for this book's relationship to the shelf.
